title: Expose canonical Gateway-ready deployment provenance on API health

phases.objective: Expose only canonical, packaged deployment provenance on /health so the Activation Gateway readiness verifier can distinguish missing upstream evidence from exact deployment drift without weakening fail-closed behavior or performing any provider, database, DNS, Cloudflare, Gateway, Staging, or Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The API health surface exposes the canonical deployment commit and packaged route-policy hash in both JSON and response headers when valid, omits malformed or unavailable evidence, and leaves Gateway deployment convergence to a separately governed rollout.
steps: Read sourceCommit only through readDeploymentManifest(env), including DEPLOYMENT_MANIFEST_PATH support for isolated tests.
Read policyHash only from the packaged staging-route-policy.json located at the runtime working directory.
Validate sourceCommit as an exact lowercase 40-hex SHA and policyHash as an exact lowercase 64-hex SHA-256.
Emit x-mad4b-deployment-sha and x-activation-gateway-policy-hash only when the corresponding canonical evidence is valid.
Emit sourceCommit and policyHash in the /health JSON body only when valid.
Omit malformed or missing provenance rather than synthesizing fallback evidence.
Run the upstream health provenance regression, Activation Gateway verifier regression, Staging Gateway convergence regression, and runtime bundle parity check.
assertions: No commit SHA or policy hash is hard-coded in runtime code.
The deployment commit is sourced from the canonical deployment manifest contract.
The policy hash is sourced from the policy artifact packaged into the Staging runtime image.
Malformed or missing manifest/policy evidence is omitted from body and headers.
Missing evidence remains fail-closed for Gateway readiness rather than being replaced by environment guesses.
The source repair performs no Gateway, Cloudflare, DNS, database, Staging deploy, or Production deploy mutation.
Production mutation remains unauthorized even though healthRoutes.js is classified as shared_runtime.

phases.objective: Keep Production rollout and provider mutation outside this source repair.
blockers: Production deployment requires a separate governed promotion after merge and independent evidence.
This PR grants no Gateway, Cloudflare, DNS, database, provider, Staging deploy, or Production deploy authority.
